jornada-ia.titulo: From chat to agent: the overview

inicio.titulo: From chat to terminal: the agent working in a folder of your own
inicio.lead: Open the terminal without fear, install the agent from the official source, set up the folder with rules, save every version with Git, keep your keys out of the text, and put your page online. Command by command, with what to check at each step.
inicio.capa_alt: A laptop with the terminal open next to a notebook with a hand-drawn folder tree.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order you do them. Each lesson ends with practice and a short quiz; only move on to the next one when the "done when" is true.

itens: People who use ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini in the browser and have never opened a terminal.
People who have already seen the program overview and want to really do step 1, with all the commands.
People who will guide a team or a client and need to know how to check what the agent did.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Move around folders in cmd (and in the Mac or Linux Terminal) always knowing where you are.
Install and sign in to Claude Code or Codex with your subscription, checking the method.
Set up the agent's folder with README, AGENTS.md, .env kept out of Git, and a history you can undo.
Publish the page on GitHub Pages and take the same project to a VPS.
